event_summary: A hand changes contact with strings on a guitar neck near the headstock, then the view shifts so the headstock leaves the frame and background objects become more visible.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a close-up of a human hand on the fretboard of a guitar-like stringed instrument near the nut and headstock. Several fingertips are visibly touching strings near the first few frets. The fingers make small position changes, and some fingers lift or move away from the strings. The hand becomes less visible toward the left side of the frame. Later, the headstock occupies the center and then shifts toward the left edge of the image as the camera view reveals more of a black rectangular case and a wooden cabinet in the background. The foreground becomes softer in focus near the end.

reasons: The guitar neck, strings, hand, and headstock are visible at close range.
The wider environment is mostly outside the frame.
The hand is already in contact with the strings at the beginning.
